name: RT Briscoe
source: CRON 20261108: rebuilt from R.T. Briscoe (Nigeria) Plc consolidated and separate statements of profit or loss and other comprehensive income for the year ended 31 December 2025 (NGX doclib filing library, page 14), N'000 scaled to NGN, GROUP columns. Printed: revenue 40,414,888 (2024: 28,634,207), cost of sales 32,054,609 (22,592,339), gross profit 8,360,279 (6,041,868), other income 2,476,223 (790,721), selling and distribution 2,032,298 (1,524,122), administrative 3,935,860 (3,037,797), operating profit 4,868,344 (2,270,670), net finance costs 1,904,008 (1,245,200), profit before taxation 2,964,336 (1,025,470), tax 161,914 (216,222), profit from continuing operations 2,802,422 (809,248), profit for the year 2,815,088 (796,561), basic EPS 2.38 (0.69). The rows previously stored for FY2025 were the COMPANY column (37,614,120 revenue) and the FY2024 profit row was the continuing-operations subtotal; both are corrected here. FY2022 and FY2021 are withheld as copies of the FY2025 group column. FY2023 values were left as found and remain unverified against any document held locally.

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Revenue - Cost of Sales = Gross Profit, and the column ties with it positive

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.identityAgreement: the audited statement prints selling and distribution plus administrative expenses of 5,968,158 and 4,561,919; the residual row nets other income of 2,476,223 and 790,721, which reproduces the printed operating profit exactly in both years
rows.derivedFrom: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedBasis: identity holds in every other period of this same file

rows.label: ROE (%)
rows.derivedCellFormula: ROE (%) = Net Profit / Total Equity x 100

derivation.ratiosNote: ratio cells tagged derived are arithmetic on the filed figures of this security, not printed in the source

derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
marketCapSource: NGX 'List of Equities as of 2026-04-09' (doclib.ngxgroup.com), shares outstanding

withheldColumns.reason: FY2022 held the FY2025 GROUP column verbatim (revenue 40,414,888, cost of sales 32,054,608, gross profit 8,360,280 all equal) and FY2021 was a byte-for-byte copy of FY2022, so neither column is a statement for its own year. Values are preserved here rather than deleted.
